title: pecluma insularis
intro: Pecluma insularis, commonly known as Island Pecluma, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pecluma insularis are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Pecluma insularis include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
